steps.title: Design gRNA target sequences
steps.instruction: Download the full‑length genomic DNA of the gene of interest (Cdt1) from NCBI (gene 81620) and Ensembl, locate the ATG start codon and TGA stop codon, copy ~15 bp upstream of ATG and ~150 bp downstream for N‑terminal tagging (or ~15 bp downstream of TGA and ~150 bp upstream for C‑terminal tagging), paste the sequence into CRISPOR or CHOPCHOP, select guides that cut within 50 bp of the ATG (or close to the stop codon), prioritize guides with high on‑target scores and few off‑targets, and export at least three top‑ranking sgRNA sequences.

steps.title: Order and resuspend sgRNA oligos
steps.instruction: Order sense oligos (5′‑CACCG[sgRNA target]‑3′) and antisense oligos (5′‑AAAC[reverse‑complement]C‑3′) from a supplier (e.g., IDT), then resuspend each in autoclaved Milli‑Q water to a final concentration of 100 µM.

steps.title: Prepare pX330 plasmid solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 8 µg of the pX330‑Cas9‑sgRNA backbone (Addgene #42230, 8 484 bp) in 16 µL Milli‑Q water to obtain 0.5 µg/µL.

steps.title: Linearize pX330 with BbsI
steps.instruction: Set up a 50 µL BbsI digestion: 27 µL Milli‑Q water, 5 µL 10× NE Buffer, 2 µL BbsI enzyme, 16 µL pX330 (8 µg). Incubate at 37 °C for 2 h, then heat‑inactivate at 65 °C for 20 min.

steps.title: Gel‑purify linearized plasmid
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1 % agarose gel (1 g agarose in 100 mL 1× TAE, add 5 µL 10 mg/mL ethidium bromide). Load 50 µL of the digestion, 2 µL of uncut pX330, and 1 µL ladder (each mixed with 0.4–1 µL 6× loading dye), run at 90 V for 45 min, excise the linearized band, and purify using a gel extraction kit.

steps.title: Prepare annealing buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 45 µL Milli‑Q water, 2.5 µL 1 M HEPES, 0.5 µL 2.5 M MgCl₂, and 2 µL 2.5 M NaCl to a total of 50 µL annealing buffer.

steps.title: Anneal sgRNA oligos
steps.instruction: For each sgRNA pair, combine 48 µL annealing buffer, 1 µL sense oligo (6 mg/mL), and 1 µL antisense oligo (6 mg/mL) for a 50 µL reaction. Run a PCR program: 90 °C 4 min, 70 °C 10 min, cool from 70 °C to 37 °C at 2 °C/min, hold 10 °C 1 min, then 4 °C.

steps.title: Ligate annealed oligos into plasmid
steps.instruction: Set up a 10 µL ligation (1:2 pX330:oligo): 4.68 µL Milli‑Q water, 1 µL 10× T4 DNA ligase buffer, 2.82 µL linearized pX330, 0.5 µL T4 ligase, 1 µL annealed sgRNA oligos (0.5893 ng, 1:200 diluted).

steps.title: Set up negative ligation control
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10 µL control without oligos: 5.68 µL Milli‑Q water, 1 µL 10× ligase buffer, 2.82 µL linearized pX330, 0.5 µL T4 ligase.

steps.title: Incubate ligation reactions
steps.instruction: Incubate ligation tubes at 16 °C overnight (or at room temperature for 2 h); optionally heat‑inactivate at 65 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Transform Stbl3 competent cells
steps.instruction: Thaw One Shot Stbl3 cells on ice 10 min, add 3 µL ligation mix to 50 µL cells, keep on ice 20 min, heat‑shock at 42 °C for 45 s, return to ice 2 min, add 400 µL SOC medium, shake at 37 °C, 200 rpm for 1 h.

steps.title: Plate transformed cells on Amp plates
steps.instruction: Spin tubes at 13 000 rpm, 1 min, RT; remove 300 µL supernatant, resuspend pellet in remaining volume, plate 100 µL on LB agar containing 100 µg/mL ampicillin, label, incubate 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Screen colonies and isolate plasmid
steps.instruction: Draw a 4 × 5 grid on the back of a fresh LB‑Amp plate, streak single colonies into grid spots, incubate 37 °C overnight, then pick 4–5 colonies into 10 mL LB‑Amp broth in 50 mL Falcon tubes, shake 37 °C, 200 rpm overnight, isolate plasmid with Qiagen Plasmid Isolation kit.

steps.title: Sequence sgRNA‑containing plasmids
steps.instruction: Prepare sequencing reactions: 10 µL plasmid (20 ng/µL), 10 µL U6 primer (10 ng/µL), 2 µL Milli‑Q water, total 22 µL (adjust to 12 µL as described), send to sequencing service and confirm sgRNA insert.

steps.title: Prepare electrophoresis agarose gel
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g agarose in 100 mL 1× TAE, microwave in 20–30 s bursts until clear, cool, add 5 µL 10 mg/mL ethidium bromide (final 0.5 µg/mL), pour into casting tray with comb, solidify at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare SDS‑PAGE resolving gel
steps.instruction: For a 5 mL 10 % resolving gel, mix 1.9 mL Milli‑Q water, 1.7 mL 30 % acrylamide, 1.5 mL 1 M Tris‑base (pH 8.8), 1.3 mL 10 % SDS, 50 µL 10 % APS, 50 µL TEMED, and 2 µL water; total 5 mL.

steps.title: Prepare SDS‑PAGE stacking gel
steps.instruction: For a 2 mL 5 % stacking gel, mix 1.4 mL Milli‑Q water, 0.33 mL 30 % acrylamide, 0.22 mL 1 M Tris‑base (pH 6.8), 0.20 mL 10 % SDS, 20 µL 10 % APS, 20 µL TEMED, and 2 µL water; total 2 mL.

steps.title: Prepare SDS‑PAGE buffers
steps.instruction: Running buffer (1×, 1 L): 14.4 g glycine, 2.9 g Tris‑base, 0.33 g SDS, 1 L Milli‑Q water. Transfer buffer (1×, 1 L): 5.8 g glycine, 3.03 g Tris‑base, 1 g SDS, 200 mL methanol, 800 mL Milli‑Q water.

steps.title: Synthesize repair template (AID‑YFP) and clone
steps.instruction: Obtain a 800 bp DNA fragment containing 500‑1000 bp homology arms flanking the Cas9 cut site in Cdt1, with AID‑YFP inserted between them (synthesized by Gene Universal). Clone the fragment into the HJURP vector using KpnI and HindIII sites, mutate the PAM in the homology arms to synonymous codons.

steps.title: Culture DLD1‑TIR1 cells for transfection
steps.instruction: Seed DLD1‑TIR1 cells in a 60 mm dish with complete DMEM (10 % FBS, 1× pen‑streptomycin) and grow to 60‑70 % confluence on the day of transfection.

steps.title: Transfect cells with sgRNA plasmid and repair template
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube combine 1 µg pX330‑sgRNA plasmid, 1 µg repair‑template plasmid, 150 µL Effectene EB buffer, and 8 µL Enhancer; vortex 1 s, incubate RT 2–5 min; add 25 µL Effectene, vortex 10 s, incubate RT 5–10 min; add 1 mL incomplete DMEM (10 % FBS, no antibiotics), mix gently.

steps.title: Post‑transfection media changes and incubation
steps.instruction: Remove complete media from the dish, wash with 1 mL incomplete DMEM, add the transfection mixture dropwise, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. After 6 h add 2 mL incomplete DMEM, incubate 24 h. Replace with 4 mL complete DMEM and incubate 24–48 h. When confluent, transfer cells to a 100 mm plate.

steps.title: Scale up cultures and harvest for sorting
steps.instruction: Five to seven days after transfection, collect conditioned media and cells for fluorescence‑activated cell sorting.

steps.title: Harvest cells and prepare conditioned media
steps.instruction: Collect media from the 100 mm plate, filter through a 0.22 µm filter into a 15 mL Falcon tube (conditioned media). In a new 15 mL tube mix 5 mL filtered media with 5 mL complete DMEM containing 20 % FBS, filter again through 0.22 µm.

steps.title: Detach cells and count for FACS
steps.instruction: Wash the plate with 1× PBS, add 1 mL 0.05 % trypsin, incubate until cells detach, add 9 mL complete DMEM, collect cells, centrifuge 200 × g 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in 5 mL 1 % FBS‑PBS, centrifuge again, resuspend in 1 mL complete DMEM, count cells, adjust to 1 × 10⁷ cells/mL.

steps.title: Single‑cell sort into 96‑well plates
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL conditioned media to each well of a 96‑well plate, then sort single cells into wells using a flow cytometer set to 1 000 events / s.

steps.title: Expand sorted clones through well plates
steps.instruction: Allow cells to reach confluence in 96‑well plates, then transfer to 24‑well, then 12‑well, and finally 6‑well plates, ensuring sufficient propagation at each stage.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA from clones
steps.instruction: Lyse cells from each 6‑well clone using the Quick‑DNA Microprep kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol and elute DNA.

steps.title: Set up PCR to screen knock‑in
steps.instruction: Prepare a 20 µL PCR mix: 10 µL 2× PCR‑Mix, 2 µL each of Primer 1, Primer 2, Primer 3 (100 µM), X µL genomic DNA (25–50 ng), add water to 20 µL.

steps.title: Run PCR products on agarose gel
steps.instruction: Thermocycle: 95 °C 5 min; 25 cycles of 95 °C 30 s, 55 °C 30 s, 72 °C 1 min; final extension 72 °C 5 min; hold 4 °C. Load 5–10 µL PCR product on a 1 % agarose gel, run, and interpret band sizes (0.5 kb wild‑type, 1 kb knock‑in, both for heterozygous).

steps.title: Sequence PCR‑positive clones
steps.instruction: Purify PCR products and submit for Sanger sequencing to confirm precise AID‑YFP insertion.

steps.title: Prepare cell lysates for western blot
steps.instruction: Harvest validated clones in 15 mL tubes, centrifuge 200 × g 3 min, discard supernatant, lyse pellets with 100 µL Pierce IP lysis buffer plus 1 µL Halt protease inhibitor (100×), keep on ice 10 min, centrifuge 18 000 × g 20 min at 4 °C, collect supernatant, determine protein concentration, add 6× Laemmli sample buffer to equalize, heat 95 °C 5 min.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE and transfer membranes
steps.instruction: Load equal‑volume samples with pre‑stained ladder onto the prepared 10 % resolving / 5 % stacking gel, run electrophoresis, then transfer proteins to a PVDF membrane using transfer buffer (1×) at appropriate voltage.

steps.title: Block and probe membranes with antibodies
steps.instruction: Block membrane in 2 % BSA in 1× PBS, incubate with primary anti‑GFP and anti‑Cdt1 antibodies, wash, incubate with HRP‑conjugated anti‑mouse or anti‑rabbit secondary antibodies, wash.

steps.title: Develop blot to confirm AID‑YFP integration
steps.instruction: Apply SuperSignal West Pico PLUS chemiluminescent substrate and capture signal according to manufacturer’s instructions; presence of GFP‑AID band confirms successful knock‑in.

steps.title: Validate GFP‑positive clones by microscopy
steps.instruction: Perform confocal immunofluorescence microscopy on GFP‑positive clones to verify correct subcellular localization of the AID‑YFP fusion.

steps.title: Treat clones with auxin for degradation assay
steps.instruction: Seed homozygous GFP‑positive clones (and DLD‑1 control) in 60 mm plates, grow to 60‑70 % confluence, then add 500 µM indole‑3‑acetic acid (IAA) for 0, 30, 60, and 120 min (concentration range 50–500 µM may be optimized).

steps.title: Harvest cells post‑auxin and analyze by western
steps.instruction: At each time point, lyse cells as described for western blot, run SDS‑PAGE, and probe with anti‑tubulin (loading control) and anti‑GFP to assess degradation kinetics.

steps.title: Create frozen stock of validated clones
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in freezing medium (90 % FBS, 10 % DMSO), aliquot, and store in liquid nitrogen for long‑term preservation.
